# 1 Samuel Chapter 21 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 21

---

### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-said David to-Ahimelech the-priest, "The-king commanded-me a-matter and-said to-me, 'Let-no-man know anything of-the-matter upon-which I-am-sendin"
- **LOGOS:** "And David said to Ahimelech the priest, "The king has charged me with a matter and said to me, 'Let no one know anything of the matter about which I a"
- **PNEUMA:** "David told the priest, "The king has sent me on a mission and instructed me: 'No one is to know anything about the mission I am sending you on or what"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline.
### Verse 4
- **EMET:** "And-answered the-priest David and-said, "There-is-no common [chol] bread under my-hand, but-there-is holy bread — if the-young-men have-kept-themselve"
- **LOGOS:** "And the priest answered David and said, "There is no common bread under my hand, but there is holy bread — if only the young men have kept themselves "
- **PNEUMA:** "The priest answered David, "I have no ordinary bread on hand — only consecrated bread. The men may have it if they have kept themselves from women." *"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "And-a-man from-[the]-servants of-Saul [was] there on-that-day, detained before YHWH, and-his-name [was] Doeg the-Edomite, [the]-chief of-the-herdsmen "
- **LOGOS:** "Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD. And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief of the herdsmen w"
- **PNEUMA:** "Now one of Saul's servants happened to be there that day, detained before the LORD. His name was Doeg the Edomite, chief of Saul's shepherds."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "And-said David to-Ahimelech, "And-is-there-not here under your-hand a-spear or-a-sword? For both my-sword and-also my-weapons I-did-not take in-my-han"
- **LOGOS:** "And David said to Ahimelech, "Is there not here under your hand a spear or a sword? For I brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the"
- **PNEUMA:** "David asked Ahimelech, "Don't you have a spear or a sword here? I didn't bring my sword or any other weapon, because the king's mission was urgent." *"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-arose David and-fled on-that day from-before Saul, and-came to-Achish king of-Gath."
- **LOGOS:** "And David arose and fled that day from before Saul. And he came to Achish king of Gath."
- **PNEUMA:** "That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath. **11** But the servants of Achish said to him, "Isn't this David, the king of the land?"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline.
### Verse 12

- **LOGOS:** "And David took these words to his heart and was very much afraid before Achish king of Gath."
- **PNEUMA:** "David took these words to heart and became very afraid of Achish king of Gath. **13** So he changed his behavior in their presence and pretended to be"

### Verse 14
- **EMET:** "And-said Achish to-his-servants, "Behold, you-see a-man acting-madly. Why do-you-bring him to-me?"
- **LOGOS:** "And Achish said to his servants, "Behold, you see the man is mad. Why do you bring him to me?"
- **PNEUMA:** "Achish said to his servants, "Look at the man — he's out of his mind! Why bring him to me? **15** Do I lack madmen that you have brought this one to c"

— SOPHIA
